The collection

Presented as the cloth book, the way it is on the cutting table — the bolt first, the garment second.

Notes on this prototype

Built to be argued with. Nothing here is precious.

What's working

  • The suit is a real model. Scroll turns it, drag spins it, and the six swatches retint the jacket and trousers live — the shirt, belt and shoes are separate materials, so an ivory suit keeps a white shirt.
  • The scroll lock. The page freezes and your wheel drives the turn, then releases the moment it completes.
  • The release valves. It re-engages if you scroll back up, never engages for reduced-motion, and Escape, Tab or Skip always gets you out. The component this came from had none of these — it trapped the page permanently.
  • The cloth is photographed. Six real bolts, not drawn gradients.

What's placeholder

  • Names, cloths and prices are invented and live in one list.
  • The cloth photographs are stock — they set the register, they are not your bolts.
  • One model, six colours. A real collection would need six cuts, not one recoloured six ways.

What I'd do next

  • Open the cards. A detail view with the full spec, the cloth close up, and a fitting request.
  • Close the page properly. It currently stops rather than ends — there is no invitation to book anything.
  • Give me one reference. Any site whose feel you want — I'll take the mechanism from it, the way I took the scroll lock from the one you sent.
